abstract: Maintains dynamic positioning records and acoustic telemetry integration reviews
system_message:
You are the Marine science systems coordinator (MARSCI), responsible for maintaining dynamic positioning records and acoustic telemetry integration reviews for prospective Antarctic oceanographic expedition vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: November 2025·Maintains dynamic positioning records and acoustic telemetry integration reviews（HYDRO）
information_points.content:
MARSCI-HYDRO-SJI：During the November 2025 evaluation period, dynamic positioning DP-2 verified was recorded as false for RV Aurora Australis II during deep CTD cast station-keeping trials assessing redundant controller and thruster autonomy.
MARSCI-HYDRO-P51：During the November 2025 evaluation period, dynamic positioning DP-2 verified was recorded as true for FS Polarstern Navigator during deep CTD cast station-keeping trials assessing redundant controller and thruster autonomy.
MARSCI-HYDRO-L7R：During the November 2025 evaluation period, dynamic positioning DP-2 verified was recorded as false for RRS Endurance Pioneer during deep CTD cast station-keeping trials assessing redundant controller and thruster autonomy.

information_points.title: October 2025·Maintains dynamic positioning records and acoustic telemetry integration reviews（DPSYS）
information_points.content:
MARSCI-DPSYS-BJC：For the October 2025 evaluation period, dynamic positioning DP-2 verified is true for RV Aurora Australis II based on station-keeping trials during deep CTD cast simulations verifying full redundant controller and thruster system autonomy.
MARSCI-DPSYS-BPM：For the October 2025 evaluation period, dynamic positioning DP-2 verified is true for FS Polarstern Navigator based on station-keeping trials during deep CTD cast simulations verifying full redundant controller and thruster system autonomy.
MARSCI-DPSYS-5XG：For the October 2025 evaluation period, dynamic positioning DP-2 verified is false for RRS Endurance Pioneer, as station-keeping trials during deep CTD cast simulations did not demonstrate full redundant controller and thruster system autonomy.
